The core of the bug is the unwanted display of the 'title' (tooltip) in the Cascader component. The most likely places where the title is set or rendered are:

1. 'src/cascader/cascader.jsx': This is the main Cascader component, responsible for rendering the overall structure and passing props to menu items. To provide an API to control the title, changes are likely needed here to add a new prop (e.g., 'showTitle' or 'disableTitle') and propagate it to child components.

2. 'src/cascader/item.jsx': This file defines the CascaderMenuItem, which is responsible for rendering each selectable item in the menu. The title attribute or tooltip is most likely set here, so this is where the logic to conditionally render or remove the title would be implemented based on the new API prop.

Other files like 'src/cascader/menu.jsx' are more about menu structure and scrolling, and do not directly handle item rendering or title attributes. The Tree-related files are not directly relevant unless the same request is made for the Tree component, but the report and image focus on Cascader.
1.bug_scenario: The bug report requests an API to remove the 'title' information from the Cascader and Tree components. The provided image shows a tooltip or title attribute displaying the full path of the selected item when hovering over a menu item in the Cascader dropdown. The user wants an option to disable or remove this title/tooltip information, which currently appears by default and may be undesirable in some use cases.
